Aisha (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: hybrid/hub + offsite rules. Drop short Qs and we'll triage.

Sam (Eng): If I need a block of 6 desks in SF for a week sprint, what's the process?

Aisha (People Ops): Submit an Offsite Request for team sprints >3 days so we can allocate space + food budget. For single-day or <3 days, use the hub booking portal: https://intranet.redwood/office-hubs

Priya (PM): Are contractors allowed at hubs for interviews? Any extra steps?

Jules (Facilities): Yes, contractors can visit with a visitor pass. Book 24h ahead and include agency/vendor name. Repeated access needs a sponsor + NDA.

Sam (Eng): Travel reimbursement timeline? Had a claim stuck.

Devon (Finance): Standard 7-10 business days after manager approval. If it's >10, DM me the claim ID and I'll escalate.

Facilities-Bot: Reminder: desk reservations open 60 days in advance. Cancel >=24h to free space.

Priya (PM): Offsite meals: company covers team dinners up to per-person cap, correct?

Aisha (People Ops): Yes. Default US cap is $250 per person per day for offsite-related costs. Anything above needs People Ops + Finance pre-approval via the Offsite Request form.

HR-Bot: Handbook update: "Workstyle & Offsite" edited at 1806234500. See: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/workstyle

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks all 8077; I'll consolidate answers into the handbook and pin links in #people-ops. If you need visa letters or special childcare stipends, DM me and we'll set a 15-min slot.
